notes.title: 1 day remaining! HYPE! FINAL PATCH READY!
notes.content:
Gameplay:
Each hat has their own stats now:
Bald head: Typical bald head.
Carrot hat: 10% increased scroll speed.
Watermelon hat: 25% chance to double collected watermelon.
PineApple hat: +1 Heart
Corn hat: 33% fruit score multiplier
Onion hat: 25% chance to double collected Onion.
Eggplant hat: 33% increased damage to bosses.
Chilli pepper: 35% increased scroll speed.

Shop changes:
Every hat was worth 500 coins, now since hats does give you upgrades their cost will be balanced.
Bald head: Free
Carrot hat: 350
Watermelon hat: 250
PineApple hat: 750
Corn hat: 750
Onion hat: 250
Eggplant hat: 1000
Chilli pepper: 1500

Edits:
Translators special thanks will be shown on the credits page.
There will be main menu random song enabled at the main menu now. There was silence if you were on the main menu, till u start any level.

Levels edits:
Watermelon looks like cactus won't spawn at the desert level cause it is too sketchy.

Vegan edits:
Now when you are are at the boss fight you won't shoot always, now you need to actually click, OR hold the left mouse button.
Bosses now will have a 2 path's. First one is hardly predictable.

Small changes:
The game now has the icon with the carrot.
